implementation.summary: Commit e621c80. parseUiAutomatorDump(stdout): List<HierarchyNodeResource> is a hand-rolled commonMain scanner, no XML library and no new dependency (compiles for iosArm64). It cuts at indexOf("</hierarchy>") -- which also makes truncated input return empty rather than throw -- then walks every tag once, finding each tag's '>' with quote-state tracking so a '>' inside an attribute value is not a tag end, and splitting name="value" pairs sequentially (per-attribute matching would hit long-clickable before clickable). Bounds must match an anchored [l,t][r,b] with toIntOrNull, else the node is skipped while its children keep their depth; coordinates are min/max-normalised so right >= left and bottom >= top (the Settings fixture has three inverted rects). text and content-desc are unescaped for exactly the five entities with & replaced last. clickable is clickable=="true" only. nodeId resolves resource-id -> text -> content-desc -> className, then any label that is not unique in the document gets a 0-based [n] suffix in document order -- both operator rulings, including a repeated resource-id such as android:id/title. HierarchyNodeResource is a data class implementing data.core.source.resource.Resource, matching DeviceInfoResource. data-device-api/CLAUDE.md updated: parser listed under parse/, behaviour note added, sealed-case count 5 -> 6, test count 39 -> 61.

troubleshooting.issue: `parseUiAutomatorDump reports an empty resource-id and clickable true on the Compose fixture` selects by bounds with single{}, but bounds="[42,201][942,336]" appears twice in MID_SCROLL_LIST_DUMP (verified by grepping the fixture: a clickable="false" android.view.View wrapper and its clickable="true" android.view.View child share the rect). The predicate is not unique in the ground truth, so the test is unsatisfiable rather than failing on behaviour.
troubleshooting.resolution: Left unedited (anti-overfit). Making it pass would require dropping or merging one of two genuinely distinct nodes, which contradicts the asserted node count of 79 in the same file. Test-side fix: add `&& it.clickable` to the predicate, or use last()/filter, or select by a depth as well.

troubleshooting.issue: The [n] collision suffix could in principle collide with a real label that already ends in [0].
troubleshooting.resolution: Accepted; uiautomator labels in the three real fixtures never do, and guarding it would cost more than it buys.
